title: Okay, Not Wonderful
text:
Okay, Not Wonderful. This Duvet Cover is super thin. It is like having white hotel sheets over your duvet. If you're using a comforter instead of a solid white duvet, know that this cover will be see through. With a solid white duvet, it is completely fine.
The peacock feathers are embroidered on, which I like. However, there are several skipped threads on the embroidery, making the feathers look a little messier than I think is intended. There were just several places where strings were hanging off.
The cover looks good. It has hidden buttons in the closure and the pillow covers are envelope back. It looks nice and crisp on the bed. It is 100% cotton, so it did need to be ironed before I put it on the bed. It is easily washable, which is a big plus. The colors are great and look beautiful.
It also does not fit like the picture. It barely covers the mattress, not the entire mattress and box springs like the ad shows.
